title: Resolving the 50 N force
caption: The 50 N force at 30° above the horizontal resolves into 43.3 N along the motion and 25 N up. Only the horizontal component does work: W = 43.3 × 4.0 = 173 J; the vertical component, perpendicular to the displacement, does none.
alt: A 50 newton force arrow at 30 degrees above the horizontal with its horizontal component of 43.3 newtons and vertical component of 25 newtons dashed.
description: The force F = 50 N is drawn at 30° above the horizontal, the direction of the crate's motion.
Dashed components: F cos 30° = 43.3 N horizontally and F sin 30° = 25 N vertically.
Work is the component along the displacement times the distance: 43.3 N × 4.0 m = 173 J.
